senses.gloss: far away from towns, cities, or other places

definition_translations.zh_TW: 遠離城鎮、城市或其他地方的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 町、都市、その他の場所から遠く離れた
definition_translations.ko_KR: 마을, 도시 또는 다른 장소에서 멀리 떨어진
definition_translations.vi_VN: ở xa thị trấn, thành phố hoặc nơi khác
definition_translations.th_TH: อยู่ไกลจากเมืองหรือสถานที่อื่น

senses.gloss: done or controlled from a distance
senses.example: The company offers remote work three days a week.

example_translations.zh_TW: 公司每週提供三天遠距工作。
example_translations.ja_JP: その会社は週3日のリモート勤務を提供しています。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 회사는 주 3일 원격 근무를 제공합니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Công ty cho phép làm việc từ xa ba ngày mỗi tuần.
example_translations.th_TH: บริษัทเสนอให้ทำงานทางไกลสัปดาห์ละสามวัน

definition_translations.ja_JP: 離れた場所から行う、または制御する
definition_translations.vi_VN: được thực hiện hoặc điều khiển từ xa
definition_translations.th_TH: ทำหรือควบคุมจากระยะไกล

senses.example: There is only a remote chance that the shipment will arrive today.

example_translations.ja_JP: その荷物が今日届く可能性はごくわずかです。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 배송물이 오늘 도착할 가능성은 매우 낮습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Khả năng lô hàng đến hôm nay là rất thấp.
example_translations.th_TH: มีโอกาสเพียงเล็กน้อยมากที่สินค้าจะมาถึงวันนี้

definition_translations.vi_VN: không có nhiều khả năng xảy ra
